title: A rental guarantee
bodyMd: A furniture rental firm promises replacement within two working days when an item fails through ordinary use. Damage caused by unauthorized modifications is excluded. A customer’s chair breaks because an outside workshop made an unauthorized alteration to its height mechanism. The firm refuses replacement under the guarantee but offers a paid repair. A consumer adviser says that this decision follows the stated guarantee; the adviser makes no claim about any rights arising outside that guarantee.
